subject: Myth & Symbolism
title: Death in the Digital Age
description: A quick win: understand Death in the Digital Age.

hook.text: Facebook has over 30 million profiles of dead users. Digital ghosts populate the internet.

buildup.text: AI can now generate conversations from a dead person's texts. Chatbots simulate the departed.

discovery.text: We're creating a digital underworld. The dead live on in data, posts, and algorithms that remember them.

twist.text: Ancient Egyptians preserved bodies. We preserve data. The impulse is the same: refuse to let the dead vanish.

climax.text: Technology has become our afterlife myth. We can't accept finality, so we build digital immortality.

punchline.text: Delete the account? No one can.

quiz.question: How does digital preservation parallel ancient death practices?
options: Both refuse to let the dead vanish
